items.period: Shang oracle script style (period attribution follows Commons file labeling; digital rendering uploaded 2009)
items.tradition: Oracle bone script style, modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern vector rendering labeled Shang oracle script style. Early forms are associated with the graph 方, but interpretations of the depicted object remain disputed.
items.alt: Dark single-stroke ancient-script-style rendering of 方 centered on a pale field.
items.selection_reason: Shows a candidate early graphic form for comparison with the later seal-style rendering while retaining the source’s script-style attribution and its limits.
items.rights: Public domain per Commons file page; digital redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition (Han dictionary tradition; modern digital rendering uploaded 2009)
items.tradition: Shuowen seal script style, modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern vector rendering labeled Shuowen seal-script style. The Shuowen paired-boats explanation is a historical account, not confirmed by the earlier graphic evidence cited here.
items.alt: Dark seal-script-style rendering of 方 centered on a pale field.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an early-style candidate with the historically influential seal-script form whose traditional interpretation differs from the CUHK paleographic analysis.
items.rights: Public domain per Commons file page; digital redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The images are modern digital redrawings identified from Commons page descriptions and provenance; their pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage, and neither is a photograph of an ancient inscription.
The labels identify script styles and source datasets; they do not settle the original referent or establish the chronology of all graphic variants.
